records.question: What caused the April 2026 ledger reconciliation mismatch, and which change fixed it?
records.gold_answer: The CHG-1072 settlement import read UTC+2 timestamps as UTC; CHG-1074 fixed it
records.answer: CHG-1072 caused the mismatch (timezone handling error); CHG-1074 fixed it

claims.text: The April 2026 ledger reconciliation mismatch was caused by a timezone handling error introduced in CHG-1072. The settlement import was reading timestamps in UTC+2 as UTC, causing late-evening transactions to shift to the following calendar day, which resulted in 312 ledger entries being recorded on the wrong date.

CHG-1074 fixed the mismatch by deploying a correction script that converted UTC+2 timestamps to UTC, aligning the affected entries with the correct settlement times. The 312 affected ledger entries were corrected to reflect the proper transaction dates, and the reconciliation process was re-run and completed successfully.

records.question: How was the slow report export problem of February 24, 2026 fixed?
records.gold_answer: CHG-1025 moved report exports to background jobs that email a download link
records.answer: CHG-1025 refactored report exports as background jobs

claims.text: The slow report export problem was caused by report generation logic running synchronously within web request handlers, which were subject to a 30-second request timeout, causing exports of more than 100,000 rows to fail.
CHG-1025 was implemented to fix the issue by refactoring report exports as background jobs, removing the dependency on the request timeout and allowing exports of any size to complete successfully.

With CHG-1025, when a merchant requests a report export, the merchant-portal service queues the export as a background job and processes it asynchronously. Once complete, the notifications service sends an email to the merchant containing a download link.
CHG-1025 was deployed by Jonas Berg on 2026-02-26 and was approved by Hannah Kim, lead of the Merchant Experience team.

The payments-api queued requests during this time and processed them once the ledger came back online.
